scientific_integrity: The proof is algebraic and all-order. Finite verifier checks are corroborative only. The primary source supplies the boundary-law system and Gibbs-measure interpretation; the new classification is independently derived from those equations.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the source invariant set \(I_3\) and the boundary family \(m=k/2+1\) for even \(k\ge4\); no assertion about other invariant sets, arbitrary Gibbs measures, extremality, stability, or free energy. A later 2025 same-object article was bibliographically visible but its full text was unavailable, leaving a stated residual originality risk.
title: Closed-form alternative Gibbs branches on the boundary family of the wand hard-core model
